hook_text: 1, 3, 6, 10, 15 — what comes next? The jumps hold the secret.
clip_script: The staircase: 1, 3, 6, 10, 15. Differences: two, three, four, five. Not constant. But the differences themselves form a pattern, increasing by one each time. That gives the way to extend it: the next difference is six, so the next term is twenty-one; then seven, giving twenty-eight.
visual_style: A block staircase grows one column at a time; jump labels +2, +3, +4, +5 pop above; the next column of 6 drops in.
pacing: Quick staircase build, pause on the jumps, reveal 21 and 28.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson for Fibonacci, square numbers and repeating patterns.
